prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single production UI reset icon, transparent PNG, for a Chinese ink painting educational app; displayed at only 44 by 44 pixels on warm ancient parchment next to an ink notebook and brush-painted close icon.
Primary request: one elegant, immediately readable counterclockwise reset/restart arrow, painted by hand with a Chinese calligraphy brush. A single nearly circular sweeping brush stroke, open at the upper left, with one clear broad arrowhead at its upper-left endpoint pointing left and slightly downward along the counterclockwise circle. Bold simple silhouette with a generous empty center. Organic brush pressure, restrained dry-brush white breaks, soft natural ink bleed only at the edges. Refined, calm, balanced traditional Chinese shuimo ink aesthetic.
Color palette: deep muted gray-green ink, approximately #3e493a, with subtle lighter ink variations. Centered square composition; icon fills about 80 percent of canvas, even margins. Medium-thick stroke suitable for legibility at 32-44px, no fine decorative details.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, including the hollow center, no paper or white rectangle, no painted backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Constraints: exactly one isolated circular arrow; no text, no Chinese characters, no borders, no seals, no additional objects, no drop shadow, no glossy/3D effects, no modern mechanically uniform vector stroke, no splash cloud.
